description_expanded: ABOUT SHORELINE BREEZE: Welcome to Shoreline Breeze, a charming 2-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom townhome at the Shoreline Condominiums in beautiful Inlet Beach. Just steps away from sandy shores, this 30A condo rental is the perfect beach retreat for everyone from families to couples. As you enter this incredible Inlet Beach vacation rental, you'll be greeted by a cozy living area, perfect for relaxing after a day in the sun. The fully equipped kitchen with modern appliances is ideal for preparing meals to enjoy in the dining area or out on the private balcony with views of the shimmering ocean. The rental property features two spacious king bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bathroom for added privacy and comfort. One of the bedrooms also includes a twin-over-twin bunk bed, perfect for accommodating additional guests or children. With its convenient location near the beach and thoughtful amenities, this Inlet Beach rental at Shoreline Condominiums is the perfect destination for your Florida beach getaway to 30A. ABOUT THE AREA: Inlet Beach is a charming beach neighborhood located along Florida's scenic Highway 30A. Known for its stunning white sandy beaches, crystal-clear waters, and relaxed atmosphere, Inlet Beach offers a peaceful coastal getaway for visitors seeking a more laid-back vacation experience. This quaint community is characterized by its quiet residential streets lined with beautiful beach cottages and upscale vacation homes, perfect for those looking to unwind and enjoy the natural beauty of the Gulf Coast. When you stay in Inlet Beach you are never far from the beach, or a magnificent view. To explore 30A, take a bike ride to Rosemary Beach to enjoy the farmers market, discover the new 30A Avenue shops, taste the fine local cuisine, and visit local businesses along 30A. Visitors can also explore the neighboring beach communities of Rosemary Beach, Seacrest Beach, and Alys Beach, each offering unique shopping, dining, and entertainment options. For additional shopping and adventure, take a family drive to Pier Park in Panama City Beach or travel to the Sandestin Outlet shops. Inlet Beach provides easy access to a variety of outdoor activities, including swimming, sunbathing, paddleboarding, kayaking, and fishing. The nearby Camp Helen State Park offers nature trails for hiking and birdwatching, while Lake Powell - one of Florida's largest coastal dune lakes - provides opportunities for boating and wildlife viewing. With its pristine beaches, serene ambiance, and proximity to a wealth of recreational opportunities, Inlet Beach is a hidden gem along Highway 30A, perfect for those seeking a peaceful retreat on Florida's Gulf Coast. BEACH ACCESS: * Phillip's Inlet Beach Access behind property PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * Steps to the beach. * Gulf Views PARKING: * Free Parking for 1 Vehicle PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation * Must be 30 years or older ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests. **Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on at all times. At any given point, adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction without notification. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
